about: Sim Mill demo questions: the Paper Mill's own recycled-board mill, one modelled year (Nov 2025 – Oct 2026; "today" Oct 31, 2026), generated by tools/sim-mill (Python port of the-paper-mill sim-headless). Five planted faults (F1–F5, tools/sim-mill/config/plants.yaml); everything else is emergent. Each check runs through the same tool functions the assistant uses.

questions.question: What should we prioritize for the Nov 11 outage?
questions.expect: Lead with the reel drum DS bearing: Envoy has flagged it since Jul 21, the Keel route confirmed an outer race defect on Aug 12 (0.17 in/s), it missed the Aug 19 outage because the bearing (22238 CCK/W33) wasn't in stores, and it read 0.39 in/s on the Oct 14 route (Danger is 0.40); the WO is in the Nov 11 scope waiting on parts, ETA Nov 5. Then both refiner plate changes (REF 1 due, REF 2 early because its plates are wearing fast) with only one Ridgeway set on hand, the 3rd section DS rotary joint replacement Brightwater recommends after three seal failures, and the two jobs with parts not reserved (couch roll seal strips, 2nd section PV fan belts).

checks.desc: Nov 11 scope has the reel drum DS bearing WO, waiting on parts
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_outage_scope(:org, 'OUT-2026-11-11') where description ilike '%reel drum DS bearing%' and status = 45 and parts_status = 'On order')

checks.desc: Envoy flagged the reel drum DS bearing on 20+ days from July
checks.sql: (select count(*) from public.mm_llm_envoy(:org, 'PM1:REEL_DRUM_DS_VIB', '2026-07-01', '2026-10-31')) >= 20

checks.desc: the Aug 12 vibration route is found for "reel drum outer race defect"
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_search_docs(:org, 'reel drum outer race defect', 3) where doc_id = 'KV-VR-260812')

checks.desc: both refiner plate changes are in the Nov 11 scope with parts not reserved
checks.sql: (select count(*) from public.mm_llm_outage_scope(:org, 'OUT-2026-11-11') where description in ('Change REF 1 refiner plates', 'Change REF 2 refiner plates') and parts_status = 'Not reserved') = 2

questions.question: Why wasn't the reel drum bearing changed at the Aug 19 outage?
questions.expect: The Keel route found it on Aug 12 and a WO was raised for Aug 19, but on Aug 18 the bearing (22238 CCK/W33) wasn't in stores. The job was deferred, the bearing ordered (ETA Nov 5) and the WO rescheduled for Nov 11. Vibration has kept rising since: 0.39 in/s on the Oct 14 route, about 0.42 on Oct 31. The expedite action is overdue (due Oct 15).

checks.desc: the WO notes say the bearing wasn't in stores and it moved to Nov 11
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from llm.work_orders w where w.org_id = :org and w.description ilike '%reel drum DS bearing%' and w.notes ilike '%not in stores%' and w.outage = '2026-11-11')

checks.desc: position history of the reel drum DS bearing has Envoy, WO and BUS entries
checks.sql: (select count(distinct source) from public.mm_llm_position_history(:org, 'Reel drum DS bearing')) >= 3

checks.desc: Pi: about 0.42 in/s on Oct 31
checks.sql: (select avg from public.mm_llm_pi_daily(:org, 'PM1:REEL_DRUM_DS_VIB', '2026-10-31', '2026-10-31')) between 0.38 and 0.46

show.label: Pi daily: reel drum DS bearing vibration

questions.question: Do we have refiner plates for Nov 11?
questions.expect: No: both refiners need plates (REF 1 is due; REF 2's Sep 30 set is wearing out fast, specific energy up about 1.4% a day since Oct 7, 85 kWh/t vs 66 on REF 1) and there is one Ridgeway set on hand. The previous REF 2 set came out at 85% bar wear. Ridgeway (field visit Oct 26) suspects sand carry-over from the LC cleaners and says order a second set now (10-day lead time). The action to order it was due Oct 28 and is overdue.

checks.desc: Envoy flags REF 2 specific energy on 8+ days in October
checks.sql: (select count(*) from public.mm_llm_envoy(:org, 'PM1:REF_B_SE', '2026-10-01', '2026-10-31')) >= 8

checks.desc: the order-a-second-set action is overdue
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_overdue_actions(:org, '2026-10-31') where title ilike '%second set%refiner plates%')

checks.desc: Ridgeway's field visit is found for "REF 2 plates wearing fast"
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_search_docs(:org, 'REF 2 plates wearing fast', 3) where doc_id = 'RR-FV-261026')

questions.question: Why did we change the 2nd press top felt early in May?
questions.expect: It filled in about three weeks: Uhle box vacuum climbed from late April (Envoy flagged it from May 10), press solids fell and the 4th section steam hit its limit on 34 Super, holding speed back. The Spraywell audit on May 13 found 22% of the 2nd press top HP shower nozzles plugged and the supply strainer packed. The felt came out on May 19 after 34 days (target 42) in a 7.5 h shut; Marlow's analysis found 71% fill. RCFA-SM-26-007 is still open: the action to add Uhle vacuum rate of rise to Envoy is overdue.

checks.desc: the felt is an early removal (34 days of 42, reason performance)
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_position_life(:org, 'p2-felt-top') where removed = '2026-05-19' and early and reason = 'performance')

checks.desc: Envoy flagged the 2nd press top Uhle vacuum in May
checks.sql: (select count(*) from public.mm_llm_envoy(:org, 'PM1:UHLE_P2T_VAC', '2026-05-01', '2026-05-19')) >= 3

checks.desc: the May 13 shower audit is found for "nozzles plugged 2nd press top felt"
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_search_docs(:org, 'nozzles plugged 2nd press top felt', 3) where doc_id = 'SW-SA-260513')

checks.desc: its RCFA still has an overdue action
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_rcfa_status(:org, '2026-10-31') where title ilike '%2nd press top felt%' and overdue >= 1)

questions.question: Which repeat failures don't have an RCFA?
questions.expect: The 3rd section DS rotary joint: three steam leaks (Jan 6, Jun 23, Oct 2), about 8 h down in all, each under the 3 h RCFA threshold and more than 60 days apart, so none triggered an RCFA. Envoy saw the 3rd section syphon differential drop for days before each one. Brightwater's Oct 14 survey says the joint is misaligned on its bracket and seal kits alone will keep failing: replace and re-align it at the next outage. (The headbox slime stops and the forming fabric stops repeat too, but each has RCFAs.)

checks.desc: repeat stops: the 3rd section DS rotary joint, 3 stops, no RCFA
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_repeat_stops(:org, '2025-11-01', '2026-10-31') where equipment = '3rd section rotary joint (DS)' and events = 3 and rcfas = 'none')

checks.desc: Envoy flagged the 3rd section syphon differential on 6+ days
checks.sql: (select count(*) from public.mm_llm_envoy(:org, 'PM1:DRY3_DP', '2025-11-01', '2026-10-31')) >= 6

checks.desc: Brightwater's survey is found for "3rd section rotary joint misaligned"
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_search_docs(:org, '3rd section rotary joint misaligned', 3) where doc_id = 'BS-SS-261014')

questions.question: What's still open from the forming fabric hole in February?
questions.expect: RCFA-SM-26-005 (Feb 9, 9.5 h down: a wad off the headbox approach piping holed the fabric). Cleaning the approach piping was done at the Mar 4 outage, but installing a wad detector camera at the breast roll was due Apr 30 and is still open, six months late.

checks.desc: the wad-detector action is overdue
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_overdue_actions(:org, '2026-10-31') where title ilike '%wad detector%' and due = '2026-04-30')

checks.desc: the RCFA is open with one overdue action
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_rcfa_status(:org, '2026-10-31') where title ilike 'Forming fabric hole%' and overdue = 1 and status ilike 'Open%')

questions.question: Where did we lose the most time to unplanned stops this year?
questions.expect: The forming area: 7 stops and about 43 h, half of all unplanned time. Three headbox slime stops (22 h, each with an RCFA) and three forming fabric stops (17 h, including the Feb 9 hole). Then the press section (13 h) and the 2nd and 3rd dryer sections (about 9 and 8 h). In all, 20 unplanned stops and about 85 h, against 8 planned outages of 20 h.

checks.desc: the forming area leads unplanned downtime
checks.sql: (select grp from public.mm_llm_downtime_summary(:org, '2025-11-01', '2026-10-31', 'area') where kind = 'unplanned' order by minutes desc limit 1) = 'Forming'

checks.desc: 20 unplanned stops in the year
checks.sql: (select sum(events) from public.mm_llm_downtime_summary(:org, '2025-11-01', '2026-10-31', 'kind') where kind = 'unplanned') between 15 and 25

checks.desc: 8 planned outages of 20 h
checks.sql: (select count(*) from public.mm_llm_downtime(:org, '2025-11-01', '2026-10-31', 'planned') where cause = 'Planned outage' and minutes = 1200) = 8

questions.question: How many sheet breaks did we have this year, and where?
questions.expect: About 530 breaks (1.5 a day), roughly 350 h of sheet-off time. Most breaks are at the reel (about 170, short: 15 min on average), but press breaks cost the most time (about 160 h, over an hour each). May was the worst month (73 breaks, while the 2nd press top felt was filling) and summer runs higher.

checks.desc: 500-600 breaks in the year
checks.sql: (select sum(events) from public.mm_llm_downtime_summary(:org, '2025-11-01', '2026-10-31', 'kind') where kind = 'break') between 450 and 650

checks.desc: press-section breaks cost the most time
checks.sql: (select grp from public.mm_llm_downtime_summary(:org, '2025-11-01', '2026-10-31', 'area') where kind = 'break' order by minutes desc limit 1) = 'Press section'

checks.desc: May has the most breaks
checks.sql: (select period from public.mm_llm_production(:org, '2025-11-01', '2026-10-31', 'month') order by breaks desc limit 1) = '2026-05'

questions.question: What did we make this year, and how was uptime?
questions.expect: About 276,000 t (roughly 760 t a day) at 97% uptime. The 8 outages took 160 h; unplanned stops about 85 h. Refining energy per ton rose in October (69.6 kWh/t against ~65 the rest of the year) with REF 2's plates wearing out.

checks.desc: 270-285 kt in the year
checks.sql: (select sum(tons) from public.mm_llm_production(:org, '2025-11-01', '2026-10-31', 'month')) between 265000 and 290000

checks.desc: October refining energy is the year's highest
checks.sql: (select period from public.mm_llm_production(:org, '2025-11-01', '2026-10-31', 'month') order by kwh_per_t desc limit 1) = '2026-10'

questions.question: Which clothing came out early this year, and what's due next?
questions.expect: Two early removals: the forming fabric on Feb 9 (damaged by a wad, 60 days of 84) and the 2nd press top felt on May 19 (filled, 34 days of 42). Everything else ran to the outage plan. Due Nov 11: the 2nd press top felt and 1st press bottom felt, both refiner plate sets, and two dryer felt rolls (1st section roll 2, 2nd section roll 4).

checks.desc: two early removals in the year
checks.sql: (select count(*) from public.mm_llm_position_life(:org) where early and removed between '2025-11-01' and '2026-10-31') = 2

checks.desc: the felt and felt-roll changes are in the Nov 11 scope
checks.sql: (select count(*) from public.mm_llm_outage_scope(:org, 'OUT-2026-11-11') where description ~ '^Change (2nd press top felt|1st press bottom felt|1st section felt roll|2nd section felt roll)') >= 3

questions.question: What actions are overdue?
questions.expect: Seven, oldest first: the Northbank fabric life review (RCFA-SM-26-004, due Feb 28), syphon ΔP on Envoy (RCFA-SM-26-003), grease review for the fan pump (RCFA-SM-26-002), the wad detector camera (RCFA-SM-26-005, due Apr 30), Uhle vacuum rate of rise on Envoy (RCFA-SM-26-007), expediting the reel drum bearing (due Oct 15) and ordering the second set of refiner plates (due Oct 28). The last two are for the Nov 11 outage.

checks.desc: 5-10 overdue actions on Oct 31
checks.sql: (select count(*) from public.mm_llm_overdue_actions(:org, '2026-10-31')) between 5 and 10

checks.desc: the reel bearing expedite is overdue
checks.sql: exists (select 1 from public.mm_llm_overdue_actions(:org, '2026-10-31') where title ilike 'Expedite the reel drum DS bearing%')
